cohort: The study included 9650 live births, representing 87.5% of all births in Jamaica between July and September 2011.
finding: The overall Neonatal Mortality Rate was 14.9/1000 live births, with maternal age <15 years, decreasing birthweight, prematurity, male gender, multiple gestation, and birth by caesarean section significantly associated with increased mortality.
mod_finding: Birth by caesarean section was associated with an increased risk of neonatal mortality.
